attn_tile_order.note: off = main = DEVIATION 2900 _bswz heaviest-causal-tile-first map (already the NVIDIA and AMD default word, so the proposed desc arm IS main). asc: _blk_map ignores SWZ (rollback, every estash kernel). zdot_asc: only the estash zdot kernel takes the ascending decode (the H100 leg measured _bswz costing zdot +6 regs, 4->3 blocks/SM, 14.79->15.61 ms). paired not built (EXPERIMENTS.md). Forward arms reach fwd r2 (lm-forward, transformer-forward); zdot_asc reaches only backward (train lanes). No bits: _blk_map is a bijection.

gemm_ozaki_linalg.note: Routes gemm/host_entry.mojo through gemm.neural_dispatch.identical_gemm_into; each arm carries the Ozaki slice count it needs (comptime assert without it). BITS CHANGE: new profile (exact int8 diagonal sums, one RNE epilogue); same words on NVIDIA and AMD by construction; the host column runs the same construction (PIECES kernel) and changes together. k > ozaki_max_k[S] falls back to the incumbent. Quality: fp32-equivalent error bound at S>=4 (neural_ozaki.mojo header); the grid quality check applies.

gemm_tile_min_blocks.note: Define-ized MOJOLEARN_GEMM_TILE_MIN_BLOCKS (env knob); the define wins over the env var when defined. off = column default (AMD 1024, NVIDIA 192). Arms equal to a column default are expected neutral on that column. Execution plan only. Reaches every gemm_identical tuned-tile caller in the build (classical included): never pack with classical.

gemm_split_min_leaves.note: off = 4 (main). Lifts the split-plan floor P >= 4 to 3 or 2 leaves: short-contraction products with outputs under the split cap get P x the blocks with the same leaves and fold tree (check_device_is_launch_invariant). Under 3/2 the P=3 batch-invariance fixtures see the split plan id (same words).

m3_angle_parallel.note: Existing define, newly gridded. Default angle kernel is b*nh*r_ang threads each serial over L tokens; the parallel arm is an integer chain (bits change vs the serial float chain; the host gen copy reads the same define, host changes together). Reference-quality check owed before any default flip.

m3_angle_block.note: Block size of the parallel angle kernel; only read with m3_angle_parallel on. Timing only.

m3_s17_tail.note: Mamba-3 backward S17 tail staging, mamba3_backward_s17_operands_into via mamba3_prefill_backward_on. One control, two arms (DBUF wins if both are set, so they are never combined). Needs the shared tail (no MAMBA3_S17_TAIL_NAIVE).

attn_fwd_tq_rule.note: Opt-in per-launch forward TQ rule (attn_fwd_rows_for may pick 16). Non-trial builds only, estash default word, head dim 64. Inert under MOJOLEARN_ATTN_TILE_RULE_OFF. Same bits.

attn_tile_rule_off.note: Rollback arm of the Oct 4 per-launch dq/dkdv tile rule (pins dq rows to ATTN_DQ_TQ and dk/dv keys to the old 32): the owed rule-removal A/B with the old rule as arm B. Backward only (train lanes). Same bits.

gemm_kpack_rpt4.note: NVIDIA kpack TUNED_128 body at 4 rows per thread (64-row tile). AMD takes the MFMA body for TUNED_128 calls: inert there. MOJOLEARN_GEMM_KPACK_CPT4 is not gridded: lib_gemm_kpack_narrow_for already selects the narrow column count on NVIDIA, so it is a no-op. EXPERIMENTS.md lists RPT4 as OPEN/unmeasured. Schedule only, same bits. Reaches classical callers.
